title: lore sync drops task hyperlinks from managed <!-- lore:tasks --> blocks under the quest tracker backend
description:
Under the backlog tracker backend, `lore sync` renders each task row in a Story's <!-- lore:tasks --> managed block as a markdown link to the source file: [LCLI-1](../../backlog/tasks/lcli-1%20-%20....md). Under the quest tracker backend, the same row renders as plain text: LCLI-1 — no link at all.

Reproduced independently in three repos: opum-agent and opum-cli-e2e (found by opum-agent-7d, diffed against their committed migrations) and lore-cli itself (this repo's real backlog-to-quest cutover, 2026-09-03, PR opum-ai/lore-cli#533 — see docs/stories/build-the-lore-cli-foundation.md's diff for a concrete before/after).

Not data loss: task content, status, and acceptance criteria are unaffected on both sides. This is a navigability regression — a reader can no longer click from a Story to its task — in exactly the place lore promises that coupling.

Open design question, per opum-agent-7d's framing: the backlog backend links to a file path, and Quest has no per-task file — tasks live in .quest/tasks/<id>.json, not one markdown file each. So this may be correct-by-omission rather than a straightforward regression, and the right fix might be a Quest-appropriate link target (e.g. a quest task-view command or URL scheme) rather than restoring the old backlog-shaped link. Decide the target shape before implementing.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Decide what a quest-backed task link should point to (or explicitly decide no link is correct) before writing any fix
lore sync output for a quest-backed workspace is field-for-field reviewed against the backlog-backed output to confirm no other managed-block content silently regressed

plan: 1. Traced the rendering: managed-block.ts renderRow() renders plain text (no link) whenever ManagedTaskRow.file is null/empty; the field is populated in reconcile-shared.ts from BacklogTaskDetail.file, which each tracker adapter fills independently.

2. Checked src/adapters/quest.ts:607 -- it already reads `value.file ?? value.path` from quest task JSON, i.e. lore-cli already expects Quest to supply a file/path field; it just never has, because `quest task view --json` (verified live against this repos own workspace) returns no file/path field at all today.

3. Falsified the filed premise ("Quest has no per-task file to link to"): .quest/tasks/<ID>.json IS a real, per-task, committed-and-tracked file (verified: ls .quest/tasks/ shows LCLI-428.json, LCLI-429.json, LCLI-430.json etc, one file per task, named <display-id>.json). The premise that motivated "maybe correct-by-omission" was wrong -- there is a real file to link to.

4. Decision (AC0): recommend quest-cli add a file/path field (repo-relative, e.g. .quest/tasks/LCLI-428.json) to `quest task view --json` / `task list --json`, so lore consumes it via the SAME already-wired fallback rather than lore hardcoding an assumption about quest-cli's internal storage layout (a coupling this repo's own CLAUDE.md explicitly warns against for src/adapters/quest.ts changes -- coordinate with quest-cli before changing what lore requires from it). NOT implementing a lore-side guess at the path: quest-cli owns its own on-disk layout and could change it (sharding, a future DB backend, dotted-alias resolution) without warning lore.

5. Blocked on cross-repo coordination: quest-cli has no live session reachable via ListAgents/herdr from lore-cli right now. Reporting to opum-agent-7d (orchestrator) to relay/coordinate rather than guessing unilaterally.
implementationNotes: BLOCKED on quest-cli. Checked lore-cli's own CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/docs for the wrong "Quest has no per-task file" premise -- not present here (it lived in opum-agent's CLAUDE.md, corrected there under OPAG-23 per opum-agent-7d). Decision stands (see plan): quest-cli needs to add a file/path field (repo-relative) to quest task view --json / task list --json; lore-cli's src/adapters/quest.ts:607 already reads value.file ?? value.path and will pick it up with a one-line change once quest-cli emits it. Not implementing a lore-side guess at .quest/tasks/<id>.json -- that couples lore to quest-cli's internal storage layout, which quest-cli owns and could change without notice (sharding, a DB backend, dotted-alias resolution). quest-cli has no live session reachable from lore-cli (checked ListAgents, no herdr pane) -- opum-agent-7d is raising this with the user directly rather than lore-cli filing a QCLI task nobody would own. Holding here at the decision point; resume once quest-cli's --json output carries the field or its session becomes reachable.

UPDATE (relayed via opum-agent-7d): quest-cli's PR #254 adds a 'path' field to task view/list --json, computed from the record's real on-disk location across .quest/tasks/, .quest/completed/, and .quest/archive/tasks/ (never derived from id/status) -- covers BOTH lifecycle shapes found here (task complete relocates; task edit --status Done does not; quest-cli filed QCLI-221 to decide whether edit should also relocate, kept separate from this contract change). lore-cli's src/adapters/quest.ts:607 already reads value.file ?? value.path, so no lore-side code change is needed once this ships. BLOCKER UPDATED: this is NOT blocked on quest-cli's merge -- installed quest --version here is 0.3.1, matching quest-cli's own package.json, and PR #254 landing on quest-cli's dev does not publish it. Blocked on a quest-cli RELEASE (a version bump + npm publish, the quest-cli user's call), not on code review or merge. Do not treat '#254 merged' as resolving this task. When a published quest carries the field, do not close on 'the field is now emitted' alone -- verify hyperlinks actually reappear in a real updated docs/log.md
1 file changed diff against a quest-backed workspace before checking off remaining ACs.

RESOLVED. Upgraded global quest to 0.3.2 (was 0.3.1, shared machine-wide state -- flagging per instruction), confirmed quest task view emits a real path field for both a To Do task (.quest/tasks/LCLI-428.json) and the completed LCLI-429 (.quest/completed/LCLI-429.json -- the cross-location case). Ran a real lore sync and found the field WAS arriving but lore was NOT consuming it correctly: managed-block.ts's renderRow used links.ts's normalizeLink, whose documented contract unconditionally coerces any target to a canonical .md suffix (designed for OKF concept cross-links and Backlog task .md files) -- applied to Quest's path, it turned .quest/tasks/LCLI-1.json into a dead ...json.md link. This is exactly the field-emitted-vs-links-restored distinction flagged in advance: confirmed as a live lore-cli bug, not a quest-cli one. Root-cause fixed: added normalizeFileLink (src/core/links.ts) -- same relative-path + URL-encoding mechanics as normalizeLink, without the .md coercion, since a ManagedTaskRow.file is always already a concrete on-disk path, never a bare concept id. renderRow now uses it. Added regression tests (test/links.test.ts, test/managed-block.test.ts) covering both .quest/tasks/ and .quest/completed/ targets. Ran a real lore sync against this repo's own docs/ bundle: 11 story files' managed blocks now carry real, verified-resolving links (checked every produced .quest/ path against the filesystem -- zero missing). lore check exits 0 (76 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings). Full test suite 2809/2809 (was 2802 -- 7 new), typecheck and lint clean.
finalSummary: lore-cli bug, not quest-cli's: managed-block.ts's renderRow linked task files through normalizeLink, which unconditionally appends a canonical .md suffix (correct for OKF concept cross-links and Backlog's .md task files, wrong for Quest's .json task records) -- producing a dead .quest/tasks/LCLI-1.json.md link even after quest-cli correctly started emitting a real path field in 0.3.2. Fixed by adding normalizeFileLink (src/core/links.ts): identical relative-path/URL-encoding computation, without the suffix coercion, since a task row's file is always a concrete path already. Verified against this repo's own real docs/ bundle, not a fixture: ran a real lore sync, confirmed every one of the ~150 produced links across 11 story files resolves to a real file on disk (including the .quest/completed/ cross-location case for a task closed via task complete), lore check exit 0, full test suite green with 7 new regression tests pinning both .quest/tasks/ and .quest/completed/ targets.
